scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

app.access_detail: Open-source local CLI; Node/browser runtime required; no account credentials.
app.surface: CLI; diagrams to SVG, PNG or PDF, not a hosted REST service
app.note: An agent-callable subprocess tool is sufficient; a native MCP server is not necessary.
app.next_action: Wrap Mermaid CLI with a fixed input directory, timeout and SVG output path, then render a small known diagram locally.
app.success_criterion: Produce a valid SVG and record the exit code; reject unexpected file paths and bound runtime.
app.alternative_action: Expose the subprocess directly as an agent tool; add an MCP wrapper only if the consuming agent requires that transport.
app.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result
